verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer offers client-facing platforms that hold client data (GDHQ corporate records, the D&O Questionnaire Portal, the Contract Generator), and it runs ChatGD on a secure enterprise Azure OpenAI instance. So asking about data retention and deletion is a fair question for this firm. However, the pack contains no evidence of user-facing retention settings, deletion controls or data-lifecycle policies on any of these tools. The firm's data-privacy practice is legal advisory work, not a product capability, so it does not count toward this story.
